_about: Public-domain Charles Edward Jefferson (1860-1937), minister of Broadway Tabernacle, New York, for the Word Hoard: his books of sermons, lectures on preaching and the pastorate, studies of the character of Jesus and of Paul, and his writings on Christianity and international peace, from Quiet Talks with Earnest People (1898) to Five Present-Day Controversies (1924). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 73 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
